page.layout: One page of text: a decorative woodcut ornament at the top; a centred title block in capitals and spaced type; a verse incipit below it; then five stanzas of Latin verse, the first with a large decorative initial; a catchword at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Qui est coluy qui trouuera femme con-

l.i: Et quae fida Sirum[?] fida domum iuuat

page.notes: The right edge of the scan is cut off: the title "BEZA", the first line "contig[?]" and the catchword are partly lost and marked with [?]. "Sirum" is doubtful (probably "virum"). The first letter of "OELIX" and "Quantus" are set in ornamented initials. The stanza "Quantus illa..." ends the visible text; the catchword is at the lower right.
